title: Commercial Credit Account Terms Schedule: Net Days and Prompt-Payment Discount
content:
**Credit Department schedule — Commercial Credit Account, all six terms tiers.**

Each Commercial Credit Account carries the terms of its tier. The columns below are the six tiers of the ladder, from Corbett Net 10 Starter Account to Corbett Net 90 Strategic Account.

### Schedule

| | Net 10 Starter | Net 30 Standard | Net 30 Preferred | Net 45 Business | Net 60 Corporate | Net 90 Strategic |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Net terms, calendar days after the invoice date | 10 | 30 | 30 | 45 | 60 | 90 |
| Prompt-payment cash discount, percent of merchandise subtotal | 0 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 0.5 | 0 |
| Discount window, calendar days after the invoice date | 0 | 0 | 10 | 10 | 15 | 0 |
| Partial payment inside the window earns the discount pro rata | no | no | no | yes | yes | no |

**Pricing tiers whose net-priced invoices never earn the cash discount (every terms tier):** Corbett Net-Price Contract; Corbett Cost-Plus Contract; Corbett Strategic Supply Agreement.

### What each line means

- **Net terms days** — days after the invoice date (statement date for consolidated billing) on which the invoice falls due; integer calendar days.
- **Prompt-payment cash discount** — percent of the invoice merchandise subtotal (never freight or sales tax); 0 means no discount offered.
- **Discount window** — calendar days after the invoice date within which payment earns the cash discount; 0 means no discount window.
- **Partial payment** — whether a partial payment made inside the discount window earns the cash discount pro rata on the merchandise portion it pays ("no" means only payment of the full invoice balance earns it).
- **Excluded pricing tiers** — the Contract Pricing Agreement tier names whose net-priced invoices never earn the cash discount (prices are already net).

### Reading the schedule

- The Corbett Net 10 Starter, Net 30 Standard and Net 90 Strategic tiers show a discount of 0 and a window of 0: those tiers offer no prompt-payment discount.
- The Corbett Net 30 Preferred and Net 45 Business tiers offer 1 percent within 10 days; the Corbett Net 60 Corporate tier offers 0.5 percent within 15 days.
- Only the Corbett Net 45 Business and Net 60 Corporate tiers show "yes" for partial payment.
